decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed use of the existing building for residential purposes, with some commercial use, would result on the loss of employment use, contrary to policy E 1.5 of the Unitary Development Plan.
2.	The density and layout of the residential proposed would lead to unacceptable loss of amenity to existing residents, through overlooking and loss of privacy, contrary to policy ENV-B 1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 
3.	The layout of the proposed parking area for the residential units would result in an unacceptable impact on the existing Grade 1 listed building of Hogarth's House, contrary to policy ENV-B 2.5 of the Unitary Development Plan  
4.	The proposed use of Short Road for additional access and parking for residential development would create unacceptable impacts on the local parking provision and access for emergency vehicles, contrary to policy T 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan 
5.	The proposed development would create an unacceptable form of residential development, through inadequate layout, lack of amenity space, and noise, contrary to policies ENV-P 1.5, ENV-B 1.1 and H 4.1 of the Unitary Development Plan
6.	 No demonstration has been submitted to show that there is no increased risk of flooding on the site or elsewhere, contrary to policy ENV-W 2.4 of the Unitary Development Plan
description: Redevelopment of existing maintenance garage and office buildings and erection of a fourth floor to provide 640 m2 B1 office accommodation and 10 x 2-bed residential units, with 12 office parking spaces provided with access from the A4, and 13 residential parking spaces with access from Short Road
